step1_figure.schematic_figure: Figure 31.18 (also realized using active CMOS topology as in Fig. 31.24 and gate-drain feedback in Fig. 31.25)
step1_figure.circuit_type: Transimpedance / Charge-Sensitive Amplifier with Shunt-Shunt Feedback
step1_figure.description: The circuit implements a high-gain CMOS telescopic-cascode core amplifier (M1-M4) biased by wide-swing cascode bias generator SUB_1, with a capacitive and reset-switch feedback network (CF and xm5) connected from output to input in a shunt-shunt feedback configuration as modeled in Figure 31.18.

open_loop_transimpedance_gain.description: Open-loop transimpedance gain AOL = v_out / i_in of the core amplifier

equation.explanation: Open-loop gain relating output voltage to input current before feedback is applied.
equation.assumptions: High cascode output impedance dominated by NMOS and PMOS cascode stages.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Ibias = 15 uA, gm1 = sqrt(2*270u*10*15u) = 284 uS. ro = 1/(0.1*15u) = 667 kOhm. Cascode output impedance Ro = (gm*ro)*ro || (gm*ro)*ro ≈ (284u * 667k) * 667k / 2 ≈ 63 MOhm. Open-loop transimpedance gain A_OL ≈ 140 dB-Ohm (10 MOhm to 100 MOhm).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Telescopic cascode configuration yields voltage gains exceeding 60 dB and extremely large output impedance.

feedback_factor_beta.description: Feedback transfer factor beta = i_f / v_o

equation.explanation: Feedback factor of the capacitive shunt-shunt feedback network.
equation.assumptions: Feedback element is purely the feedback capacitance CF = 10 fF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by feedback capacitor CF = 10 fF.

closed_loop_transimpedance_gain.description: Closed-loop transimpedance gain ACL = vo / is

equation.formula: A_CL = v_o / i_s = A_OL / (1 + A_OL * beta) ≈ 1 / beta = 1 / (s * CF)
equation.explanation: Closed-loop transimpedance gain under strong negative feedback.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain scales inversely with frequency and capacitance CF = 10 fF.

closed_loop_input_impedance.description: Closed-loop input impedance Rinf with shunt feedback

equation.explanation: Shunt mixing reduces the input impedance by the feedback factor (1 + AOL*beta).

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to Miller effect on CF, input capacitance Cin_eff = (1 + Av)*CF ≈ 1000 * 10 fF = 10 pF. Zin = 1 / (s * Cin_eff) ≈ 160 kOhm at 100 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Shunt-shunt capacitive feedback causes large virtual-ground capacitance Cin_eff.

equation.explanation: Shunt sampling reduces the output impedance by the amount of feedback.

sky130_expected.calculation: Open loop Ro ≈ 63 MOhm. With loop gain T ≈ 100 at midband, Rof ≈ Ro / 101 ≈ 600 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Feedback substantially lowers open-loop cascode output resistance.

transient_integration_slope.description: Transient output voltage ramp rate dv_out/dt during integration

equation.explanation: Integration slope of charge amplifier with constant input current source I1.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I1 = 10 pA and CF = 10 fF: dv/dt = 10e-12 / 10e-15 = 1000 V/s = 0.001 V/us = 1 mV/us. Over 30 us, delta_V = 30 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct integration of input current I1 onto feedback capacitance CF.

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: SUB_1 draws ~100 uA total; cascode core amplifier draws ~15 uA. Itot ≈ 115 uA * 1.8V ≈ 207 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Wide-swing cascode bias network and core branch under nominal Sky130 operating conditions.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench measuring DC operating point, power dissipation, open-loop and closed-loop AC transimpedance response, output/input impedances, and transient integration ramp rate over 30us.
